title: Scan
suits: earth observation, mapping, climate data, satellites, imaging, sensing and analytics: products that turn raw signals into a clear picture

params.--field: the sea under the swath; graticule and terrain classes are tinted from it
params.--brand: the mark and the second, truer pass
params.__MARK__: stroke paths in a 24 x 24 box; the canvas images them stroke for stroke

details: a tiny satellite rides the top of the scan line across the field
the scan line itself is thin and noisy, like a real sensor
the strip behind the line lights up as the instrument's footprint
the lockup comes out of the swath as if imaged: coarse false-colour blocks right behind the line
the image resolves through finer, truer passes to sharp type about half a second later
tick marks run along both swath edges as it goes
the footprint and ticks fade once the image is in
a faint graticule sits under everything, tinted from the field
terrain classes in the coarse pass are drawn from the field and brand colours
film grain and a soft vignette give the field depth
